name: Silkface Screen
description: Flicks the fan open with a pulse of qi so the sudden crack of the ribs startles the opponent.

name: Waftflog
description: Cuts the outer rib forward and down across the opponent's lead arm with a short step.

name: Rimribprop
description: Blocks a cut on the closed spine and slides the blade away while the rear foot steps back.

name: Veering Guardrib
description: Walks forward with the opened fan held before the face and the free hand ready at the hip.

name: Swift Flutter
description: Spreads the fan during a long step so the outer rib slashes the flank as the body passes.

name: Sturdy Fanrib
description: Crosses the ribs over an incoming blade and turns the whole body behind it to stand outside the line.

name: Rustlescorer
description: Taps the weighted pivot end sharply against the opponent's temple side with a light rising swing.

name: Resolute Rivetpin
description: Drops the opened leaf over the hip and thigh to catch a low cut before it lands.

name: Armored Spreadface
description: Slaps the back of the fan against an incoming forearm to turn the blow toward the outside.

name: Stern Pivotpin
description: Leans the shoulders under a swing and cuts up through the armpit with the open edge.

name: Pirouetting Foldedge
description: Shuffles backward in three short steps while the fan hand keeps the opponent's weapon covered.

name: Rough Waft
description: Sweeps the outer rib across the wrist and hooks the second rib over it to drag the arm down.

name: Sturdy Fantip
description: Twists the fan against a thrust so the ribs ride the point wide and the edge returns to the throat.

name: Fantipslap
description: Hinges the wrist alone to cut a short arc across the opponent's gripping hand.

name: Unmoving Fanspine
description: Rolls the opened fan in a steady circle before the chest so a hail of light cuts spend themselves on it.

name: Wild Snapshut
description: Beats the shut tip against the opponent's lead shoulder to hold them at the edge of reach.

name: Rustlestalk
description: Drags the rear foot in a wide arc while the fan hand sweeps the opponent's guard outward.

name: Binding Fanout
description: Shakes the ribs against the opponent's ear mid-breath so the next strike comes late.

name: Stalling Rimrib
description: Catches a blade at the pivot pin and twists the fan so the sword is held crossways.

name: Tethering Wavering
description: Flashes the polished leaf into the eyes and steps through to the opponent's rear shoulder while they blink.

name: Guardrib Screen
description: Raises the iron-ribbed fan on an in-breath so a heavy chop strikes its flat and rebounds.

name: Ruthless Rustle
description: Brings the weighted outer rib down on the opponent's collarbone with the full turn of the hip.

name: Brawn Pivotpin
description: Thrusts the shut fan under the raised arm into the side of the chest.

name: Poise Rivetpin
description: Spins the open fan on its rivet at the wrist to wipe aside a swarm of short cuts.

name: Staticfantip
description: Hooks an iron rib behind a sword guard and drags the weapon out of true.

name: Brawnrimrib
description: Stamps the lead foot to hold the opponent's gaze then slams the folded fan across the ribs.

name: Fanribbuckle
description: Drops the iron fan flat against a low charge and drives the pivot end into the back of the neck.

name: Emberrimrib
description: Swings the heavy fan in a continuous circle beating each guard it meets until the opponent's stance cracks.

name: Gripping Foldedge
description: Presses the iron ribs into the crook of the elbow and levers the arm straight behind the opponent.

name: Brawnfanrib
description: Cuts the outer rib across the chest in an X pattern with a pulse of qi through each stroke.

name: Sleetfanrib
description: Folds the pleated leaf in half in front of the chest to meet a thrust on the stiffened ribs.

name: Emberrustle
description: Whips the wrist backward to strike the cheek with the back rib after a passing parry.

name: Draught Flutter
description: Hops a half pace sideways and pivots the fan arm with the body to face a flanker.

name: Viselike Silkface
description: Spreads the fan sharply at eye level so the opponent loses sight of the lead foot.

name: Spreadface Barrier
description: Folds the fan around a punching wrist and rolls the arm off to the side.

name: Brawn Rustle
description: Beats the ribs high then middle then low in a rapid triple strike that finishes at the knee.

name: Brawn Fanspine
description: Closes the fan against the chest and presses forward so the opponent's raised weapon cannot swing.

name: Hum Fanrib
description: Opens the leaf to slide a thrust aside and slashes the outer rib across the exposed wrist.

name: Brawnfanout
description: Spins away from a lunge on a retreating step and lets the open edge trail across the chaser's face.

name: Stubborn Fanspine
description: Turns the leaf face-out so arrows and thrown stones strike the lacquered surface.

name: Clayfanrib
description: Jabs the folded tip at the throat hollow and snaps it back to the guard in one beat.

name: Grit Fanout
description: Turns on the pivot foot as the leaf swings round to follow the line of an enemy's step.

name: Mirage Wavering
description: Flicks the leaf corner at the opponent's eyes to spoil the aim of the next cut.

name: Stamp Fantip
description: Rolls the leaf around a sword blade and tightens the ribs on it until the weapon sticks fast.

name: Draught Waft
description: Cuts across with the edge and in the same turn brings the leaf round to cover the cutting arm.

name: Sprigfanrib
description: Closes two ribs on an opponent's wrist and holds fast until the fingers go slack.

name: Discord Pivotpin
description: Drags the open leaf across the front of a raised weapon to pull it out of position.

name: Honedfanout
description: Raps the iron spine low against the shin bone to slow a kicker.

name: Fanout Hurdle
description: Shifts the stance sideways while folding the fan shut so it stays close to the body.

name: Viselike Rimrib
description: Hooks the open ribs inside a collar and hauls the head down toward the waiting knee.

name: Sleet Waft
description: Locks the ribs about the forearm and twists the fan so the opponent is spun onto their back.

name: Static Flutter
description: Hooks both the weapon hand and the guard with the open ribs and steps back to pull them free.

name: Guarding Rivetpin
description: Slaps the leaf edge against a wrist at the moment it begins to cut.

name: Fanoutswat
description: Sweeps the outer rib low across both shins at the end of a retreating step.

name: Coasting Rustle
description: Shifts to the outside of the opponent's forward foot and holds the fan across the middle.

name: Poise Guardrib
description: Beats a rising blade downward with the iron rib until the point strikes the ground.

name: Fantipthwack
description: Slices the sharpened pleat edge across the back of the sword hand as it rises.

name: Wafthasp
description: Presses the open fan flat onto the chest and drives forward to knock the opponent back a pace.

name: Rugged Wavering
description: Slices the fan edge through the gap in a defending arm and cuts through the opponent's balance.

name: Splicerustle
description: Closes the leaf over the point of a thrust so the fan pins the weapon against the ribs.

name: Sleet Fantip
description: Blocks the opponent's first blow flat on the open fan and backs away a pace.

name: Honed Foldedge
description: Flicks the closed ribs up from below to crack against the opponent's brow.

name: Clayfanout
description: Weaves forward from side to side while the fan sweeps loose arcs in front of the body.

name: Burdening Fanrib
description: Hooks the outer rib behind the elbow and drags the arm across the opponent's own body.

name: Sturdy Rimrib
description: Angles the open leaf sidelong so a straight thrust skids off the lacquer.

name: Brass Fantip
description: Snaps the fan shut against the opponent's ribs at the end of a half step.

name: Foldedge Hasp
description: Folds the fan over a downward cut and thrusts the shut tip into the belly in the same beat.

name: Recall Silkface
description: Sweeps the leaf low to throw dust at the eyes and sidesteps behind the cloud.

name: Splice Silkface
description: Locks the wrist in the ribs and turns the opponent's own arm into a barrier then strikes the exposed flank.
